mapper.sql: deliveries.id AS id, deliveries.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, deliveries.`date` AS `date`, deliveries.`code` AS `code`, deliveries.`note` AS `note`, deliveries.location_group_id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, deliveries.cgroup_id AS customerGroupId, cgroups.name AS customerGroupName, deliveries.customer_id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, deliveries.delivery_by AS deliveryId, employees.name AS deliveryName, deliveries.status AS status, deliveries.created AS created, deliveries.is_approve AS isApprove, deliveries.approved AS approved, CONCAT(approver.first_name, ' ', approver.last_name) AS approvedBy, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, deliveries.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM deliveries LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = deliveries.company_id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = deliveries.location_group_id LEFT JOIN cgroups ON cgroups.id = deliveries.cgroup_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = deliveries.customer_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = deliveries.delivery_by LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = deliveries.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = deliveries.modified_by LEFT JOIN users AS approver ON approver.id = deliveries.approved_by

WHERE deliveries.status >= 0
AND ( deliveries.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )
mapper.select: SELECT delivery_details.id AS id, sales_orders.id AS salesInvoiceId, delivery_details.sales_order_detail_id AS salesInvoiceDetailId, sales_orders.order_date AS invoiceDate, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, sales_orders.order_id AS saleOrderId, products.id AS productId, products.name AS productName, location_groups.id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, delivery_details.location_id AS locationId, delivery_details.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, delivery_details.expired_date AS expiredDate, delivery_details.qty AS qty FROM delivery_details LEFT JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.id = delivery_details.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = delivery_details.product_id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = sales_orders.location_group_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = delivery_details.uom_id WHERE delivery_details.delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deliveries ( company_id, `date`, `note`, location_group_id, cgroup_id, customer_id, delivery_by, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{delivery.companyId}, #{delivery.date}, #{delivery.note}, #{delivery.warehouseId}, #{delivery.customerGroupId}, #{delivery.customerId}, #{delivery.deliveryId}, NOW(), #{delivery.createdBy}, #{delivery.status} )

INSERT INTO delivery_details ( delivery_id, sales_order_id, sales_order_detail_id, product_id, location_id, uom_id, expired_date, qty ) VALUES ( #{detail.deliveryId}, #{detail.salesInvoiceId}, #{detail.salesInvoiceDetailId}, #{detail.productId}, #{detail.locationId}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.expiredDate}, #{detail.qty} )
mapper.select: SELECT location_id FROM ${warehouseId}_group_totals WHERE location_group_id = #{warehouseId} AND total_qty > 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: DELETE FROM stock_orders WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesInvoiceId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND location_group_id = #{warehouseId}
UPDATE sales_orders SET delivery_id = #{deliveryId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sales_orders SET status = 2 WHERE id = #{salesInvoiceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM order_details WHERE order_id = #{saleOrderId}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sales_order_details WHERE sales_order_id IN (SELECT id FROM sales_orders WHERE status > 0 AND delivery_id IS NOT NULL AND order_id = #{saleOrderId})
